description: Plugin hooks for project-toolkit. Every registration routes through invoke_dispatch_claude.py (one process per (event, matcher) group, issue #3075); membership lives in dispatch_groups.json (plugin-* groups). Inside a checkout of the repo that publishes this plugin, the dispatcher exits immediately so hooks do not double-fire with .claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: _ptr="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; _warn="project-toolkit@ai-agents WARNING: hooks DISABLED (your session is unaffected)."; if [ -z "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root unresolvable (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT empty). Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root is not a directory: $_ptr. Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; _i=""; for _c in python3 python; do if command -v "$_c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then _ok=$("$_c" -I -c "import sys;print(int(sys.version_info>=(3,10)))" 2>/dev/null) || _ok=""; if [ "$_ok" = "1" ]; then _i="$_c"; break; fi; fi; done; if [ -z "$_i" ]; then echo "$_warn No suitable Python interpreter found (need >= 3.10). Install: https://www.python.org/downloads/" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" ]; then echo "$_warn Dispatcher missing or not a file: $_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py. Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -r "$_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" ]; then echo "$_warn Dispatcher unreadable: $_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py. Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; "$_i" -I -u "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" --group plugin-stop-1-reflect_nudge --advisory; _rc=$?; if [ $_rc -eq 126 ] || [ $_rc -eq 127 ]; then echo "$_warn Python interpreter failed to start ($_i, exit $_rc). Install Python >= 3.10: https://www.python.org/downloads/" >&2; exit 0; fi; exit $_rc

_ptr="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; _warn="project-toolkit@ai-agents WARNING: hooks DISABLED (your session is unaffected)."; if [ -z "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root unresolvable (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT empty). Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root is not a directory: $_ptr. Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi;
_physical_dir() (
  CDPATH=; command cd -P -- "$1" 2>/dev/null && command printf "%s." "$PWD"
)
_project=$(_physical_dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}") || {
  echo "$_warn Cannot resolve the project directory." >&2; exit 0
}
_project=${_project%.}
# Include the containing checkout when the host starts under a subdirectory.
_parent=$_project
while :; do
  if [ -d "$_parent/.git" ] || [ -f "$_parent/.git" ]; then _project=$_parent; fi
  if [ "$_parent" = / ]; then break; fi
  _parent=${_parent%/*}; _parent=${_parent:-/}
done
_in_project() {
  _ancestor=$1
  while :; do
    if [ "$_ancestor" -ef "$_project" ]; then return 0; fi
    if [ "$_ancestor" = / ]; then return 1; fi
    _ancestor=${_ancestor%/*}; _ancestor=${_ancestor:-/}
  done
}
_safe_python() (
  _file=$1
  _links=0
  while :; do
    _dir=$(_physical_dir "${_file%/*}/") || return 1
    _dir=${_dir%.}
    if _in_project "$_dir"; then return 1; fi
    _file=${_dir%/}/${_file##*/}
    if [ ! -L "$_file" ]; then
      [ -f "$_file" ] && [ -x "$_file" ]; return
    fi
    _links=$((_links + 1))
    if [ "$_links" -gt 40 ]; then return 1; fi
    # Preserve filename bytes when command substitution strips trailing newlines.
    _target=$(command -p readlink "$_file" && command printf ".") || return 1
    _target=${_target%.}; _target=${_target%?}
    case $_target in
      /*) _file=$_target ;;
      *) _file=${_dir%/}/$_target ;;
    esac
  done
)
# Filter PATH for the interpreter and any commands it starts.
_safe_path=
_paths=${PATH-}:
while [ -n "$_paths" ]; do
  _dir=${_paths%%:*}; _paths=${_paths#*:}
  case $_dir in /*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
  _dir=$(_physical_dir "$_dir") || continue
  _dir=${_dir%.}
  # A canonical directory containing the separator cannot be a PATH entry.
  case "$_dir" in *:*) continue ;; esac
  if _in_project "$_dir"; then continue; fi
  _safe_path=${_safe_path:+"$_safe_path:"}$_dir
done
_i=
for _name in python3 python3.exe python python.exe; do
  _paths=${_safe_path:+$_safe_path:}
  while [ -n "$_paths" ]; do
    _dir=${_paths%%:*}; _paths=${_paths#*:}
    _candidate=${_dir%/}/$_name
    _safe_python "$_candidate" || continue
    _ok=$(PATH=$_safe_path "$_candidate" -I -c 'import sys; print(int(sys.version_info >= (3, 10)))' 2>/dev/null) || continue
    if [ "$_ok" = 1 ]; then _i=$_candidate; break 2; fi
  done
done
if [ -z "$_i" ]; then echo "$_warn No suitable Python interpreter found (need >= 3.10). Install: https://www.python.org/downloads/" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" ]; then echo "$_warn Dispatcher missing or not a file: $_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py. Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -r "$_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" ]; then echo "$_warn Dispatcher unreadable: $_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py. Reinstall: /plugin install project-toolkit@ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; PATH=$_safe_path "$_i" -I -u "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" --group plugin-userpromptsubmit-1-memory_recall; _rc=$?; if [ $_rc -eq 126 ] || [ $_rc -eq 127 ]; then echo "$_warn Python interpreter failed to start ($_i, exit $_rc). Install Python >= 3.10: https://www.python.org/downloads/" >&2; exit 0; fi; exit $_rc
